subject: Important Update: Your recent purchase
body: Dear valued customer, Thank you for your recent purchase with us. We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in the shipment of your order. Our team is working diligently to resolve this issue and ensure your package arrives as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs.
